en.bilal-muhammad: Muhammad b. `Umar al-Hafith al-Baghdadi narrated to us. He said: Abu Muhammad al-Hasan b. `Abdullah b. Muhammad b. `Ali b. al-`Abbas al-Tamimi al-Razi narrated to me. He said: My father narrated to me. He said: My Master `Ali b. Musa al-Rida narrated to me. He said: My father Musa b. Ja`far narrated to me. He said: My father Ja`far b. Muhammad narrated to me. He said: My father Muhammad b. `Ali narrated to me. He said: My father `Ali b. al-Husayn narrated to me. He said: My father al-Husayn b. `Ali narrated to me. He said: My father `Ali b. Abi Talib (as) narrated to me.  He said: The Messenger of Allah (s) said:
I and `Ali were created from one light.
